# openobserve_dashboards (Data Source)

Lists the dashboards of an OpenObserve organization, optionally scoped to one folder.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_dashboards" "platform" {
  folder_id = data.openobserve_folder.shared.folder_id
}

output "dashboard_titles" {
  value = [for d in data.openobserve_dashboards.platform.dashboards : d.title]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `folder_id` (String) Restrict the listing to one folder. Omitting it lists the `default` folder, matching the API's own behaviour.
- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `dashboards` (Attributes List) The dashboards found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dashboards))
- `id` (String) Data source ID.

<a id="nestedatt--dashboards"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dashboards`

Read-Only:

- `dashboard_id` (String) Dashboard identifier.
- `description` (String) Dashboard description.
- `folder_id` (String) Folder holding the dashboard.
- `folder_name` (String) Name of that folder.
- `owner` (String) Dashboard owner.
- `title` (String) Dashboard title.
- `updated_at` (Number) Timestamp of the last modification.
- `version` (Number) Dashboard schema version.
